section_1_what_we_are_building.one_line: Governed custody & intelligence platform for a regulated audio-first data estate.
section_1_what_we_are_building.core_value: The estate can be used (for training, decisioning, reporting) without ever leaving custody, without leaking biometric or named-person material, and without silent regulatory drift.
section_1_what_we_are_building.primary_users: The enterprise that owns the estate; internal audit; regulators-under-pilot; downstream ML/analytics consumers gated through the release_gate.
section_1_what_we_are_building.problem_solved: Rather than export recordings, run a custody-first pipeline in-place: raw audio never leaves; only owner-ratified derivative products (transcript triples, tokenised named-persons, discriminated-kind embeddings) can be lifted; every dispatch to an unregistered resource is recorded and alerted.

framing.governed_census: enumerate what audio the enterprise owns (Path C default corpus_deliverable_v1 pointer triples)
framing.audio_intelligence_plane: condense the estate into derivative products (Path B derivative corpus, shape β 6-carrier segments)
framing.release_gate: refuse any product that crosses a governance line unless an explicit owner ruling has admitted it (Ruling #5 tier-lift)
